1829-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

5078-6766-7297-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

985-4460-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-2393-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-2393-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

4826-5222-6495-6644.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.
4826-5222-6495-6644.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2292-2738-4314-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1580-2301-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

49-2034-4871-5998-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Repeat.

3490-4659-4716-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-4716-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

431-851-1308-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1308-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

454-509-1267-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
454-509-1267-5548.description:
Cause Medomai to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-5231-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-5231-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

56-789-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-789-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Gutter Grime trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-789-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

225-2034-2653-5552.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least ten permanents.
225-2034-2653-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

2103-3662-5131.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
2103-3662-5131.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Capture of Jingzhou from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

575-3703-4121-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-3703-4121-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Birchlore Rangers.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Birchlore Rangers.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Birchlore Rangers enters the battlefield, Sporemound ttriggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers' morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2073-2363-2866-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
2073-2363-2866-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken noncreature artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scrap Trawler and Salvaging Station trigger.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to cast Hangarback Walker, and then sacrifice Hangarback Walker to Krark-Clan Ironworks to get infinite 1/1 Thopter creature tokens.

2060-2230-4120.notablePrerequisites: Polukranos has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-2230-4120.description:
Pay {1}{B}{G} to have Polukranos fight Crystalline Crawler.
Vigor prevents the damage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Polukranos and four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Remove three +1/+1 counters from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

1805-4222-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Pyramid of the Pantheon does not have summoning sickness.
Pyramid of the Pantheon has at least three brick counters.
1805-4222-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Pyramid of the Pantheon to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.
